name: Commander Mar'alith
summary: At Cenarion Hold, Commander Mar'alith holds the line against the dangers of Silithus. He leads the fight against silithid swarms and Twilight's Hammer cultists, while grief over his missing wife weighs on him.

sections.title: Commander of the Hold
sections.body: At Cenarion Hold, Commander Mar'alith guards the Cenarion Circle's desert stronghold. The druids study Silithus's ancient ecological and cosmic anomalies, while he directs the work of war. His forces strike at the silithid hives of Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal. They keep the incursions from overwhelming the expedition's central foothold.

sections.title: Grief in the Desert
sections.body: Commander Mar'alith's stern bearing cannot hide his grief. His beloved wife, Natalia Mar'alith, went into the shifting sands on an assignment for the Circle and did not return. He holds to his duty to the Cenarion expedition, though he longs for news of what happened to her in the wastes.

sections.title: A Tragic Fate
sections.body: Natalia Mar'alith succumbed to madness amid the desert's whispers. Then a Qiraji crystal brainwashed her into serving C'Thun. The truth leaves Commander Mar'alith deeply shaken. Even through heartbreak, he directs Silithus's defense against the horrors below.

faq.answer: Commander Mar'alith commands the Cenarion Circle's military forces at Cenarion Hold. He organizes scouts, defenses, and strikes against the silithid hives across Silithus.

faq.q: Where can Commander Mar'alith be found?
faq.answer: Commander Mar'alith can be found inside Cenarion Hold, the Cenarion Circle's main neutral settlement in the sands of Silithus.

faq.q: What happened to his wife, Natalia?
faq.answer: Natalia Mar'alith vanished into the desert during an expedition and never returned. Following her trail through Silithus reveals what became of her.
Sorrow and anxiety over his missing wife and her fate weigh on Commander Mar'alith. Even so, he directs the fortress's defense.

faq.q: What tasks does Commander Mar'alith assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Commander Mar'alith sends champions against silithids in Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal. He also sets them against the Twilight's Hammer and asks them to investigate his wife's fate.
No. Commander Mar'alith is an armored sentinel and warrior commander. He directs the expedition's military defense and tactics rather than wielding druidic magic.

angles.text: As a night elf, you share the sentinels' and warriors' devotion to guarding Kalimdor beside the druids, even at great personal cost.
As a warrior, you know the work of battlefield command. Mar'alith directs the fighting in heavy armor and bears a massive glaive among the settlement's mystics and nature keepers.
